title: We're on track to deliver the...
content_text:
We're on track to deliver the new dashboard by Friday, and the team is feeling good about the progress.
That said, I want to flag a potential risk — the third-party API has been unstable, and it could slip our timeline.
To be honest, I think we're spreading ourselves too thin, so we should deprioritize the reporting module until next sprint.
I'll admit I'm a bit stretched right now juggling three workstreams, but I can reprioritize if we agree this is the top concern.
If we're aligned on that, I'll update the roadmap and send the revised timeline to stakeholders by end of day.
